One vendor per role family

Review how Codility produces its scores before you sign
A product demo can show the assessment and the report. Your legal and procurement reviewers also need to understand how Codility produces each score.
Codility scores business-task output against an expert-defined set of acceptable answers.
Codility scores engineering tasks automatically against test cases.
Business-task and engineering-task scoring are deterministic: the same submission receives the same score every time.
Validation documentation
For engineering assessments, Codility provides audit-ready validation documentation for procurement and legal review, prepared by PhD-level industrial and organizational psychologists. Tony Mellek, PhD, leads assessment science at Codility.
Adverse impact analyses
For enterprise customers, Codility’s professional services team can also run adverse impact analyses on your assessment results. The analyses use methods aligned with US Equal Employment Opportunity Commission guidance, including the four-fifths rule.
Your legal and procurement reviewers can examine the scoring method before you sign.
Adverse impact analysis, ready for your legal review.
Check how Codility handles AI and hiring decisions
Your risk team needs a clear record of where an assessment vendor uses AI. Candidates can use the AI Assistant inside a Codility assessment when your team enables it.
You control the AI Assistant setting per assessment.
Codility captures every candidate interaction as reviewable AI activity.
No AI or machine learning model makes automated hiring decisions at Codility. Your hiring team remains accountable for each decision.
Your risk team can document how AI is used in the assessment process before approving the vendor.

How to evaluate a talent assessment company
Compare the talent assessment companies on your shortlist with the same seven questions.
Bring these seven questions to the kickoff call for your Codility free trial.
Start the trial with the form below
Role coverage.
Ask which of your roles the vendor assesses with a realistic task, and which with a questionnaire or a knowledge test.
Validation documentation.
Ask for the documentation behind the scores, and ask who prepared it.
Adverse impact.
Ask for adverse impact analysis at the cut scores you plan to use.
Scoring consistency.
Ask whether the same submission always receives the same score.
AI policy.
Ask how the vendor sets the AI policy for each assessment and records candidate AI use.
Design support and setup.
Ask who helps your team design assessments, and how long setup takes.
Security and hosting.
Ask for the security audit report and the data hosting regions you can choose.

One vendor and one scoring engine for business and engineering hiring
Frequently asked questions about choosing a talent assessment company
A talent assessment company provides the assessments, the scoring method and the support an employer uses to evaluate candidates. Hiring teams also call these vendors pre-employment assessment companies. Codility provides work simulations for business roles and engineering roles.
Codility assesses candidates with work simulations and scores the output each candidate produces. Business candidates work in a simulated workplace, while engineering candidates work in a realistic development environment. Codility scores each submission deterministically.
Codility assesses candidates for business roles and software engineering roles. For hiring in business functions, AI for Business covers roles including customer support, customer success, sales, product management, product marketing, marketing, data analysis and finance. General workforce tasks cover other business roles. For engineering hiring, Codility’s library holds more than 1,300 validated engineering tasks across the tech stacks your business uses.
Codility does not offer personality questionnaires or cognitive ability tests. Codility assesses candidates through work simulations instead.
Greg Jakacki, a competitive programmer, founded Codility. Tony Mellek, PhD, leads the assessment science team. The company is headquartered in London, with offices in Poland, Germany and the United States.
Codility is SOC 2 Type II audited and ISO 27001 certified. The current SOC 2 Type II report is available under a nondisclosure agreement. Codility is GDPR and CCPA compliant. Codility offers EU and US data hosting. You choose the region at contract time.
Codility connects with 21 major platforms, including Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday, SAP and SmartRecruiters.
Most customers are operational within four weeks. Your integration and assessment requirements determine the exact launch date.
A premium provider can be worth the higher price when it lowers the total cost of assessment over the full contract term. Compare implementation, integrations, support and task maintenance, not only the license. Include the time your team would spend preparing validation evidence for legal review if a vendor does not supply it. If one vendor covers only one role family, include the cost of a second contract and vendor review. Codility publishes prices for its self-serve plans on the pricing page. Codility’s sales team provides enterprise pricing.
Codility Skills Intelligence assesses the employees you already have. For business functions, the same AI for Business work simulations run through Skills Intelligence.
